title: Space used by the transfer machine
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $w$ assign a Boolean word to each of the $k$ work tapes. Choose distinct tape indices $\mathrm{src}$ and $\mathrm{dst}$, and suppose the destination tape's word is empty. Starting from the configuration in the sweep phase with these words stored from cell zero, for every time $t$, the number of cells visited by the source head through step $t$ is at most $|w(\mathrm{src})|+2$, and the same bound holds for the destination head. Every other work-tape head visits exactly one distinct cell through step $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{src}$ and $\mathrm{dst}$ are indices among the $k$ tapes
$w$ is a family of Boolean words indexed by the tapes
the destination tape's word is empty
